mods.name: terse-mode
mods.description: Short answers: no preamble, no recap.

mods.name: plain-english
mods.description: Writes in ASD-STE-100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice, simple words.

mods.name: junior-mode
mods.description: Explains each step and why, and defines jargon once, for a learner.

mods.name: reply-language
mods.description: Answers in the language you set (English by default). Code, identifiers and commands stay as they are.

mods.name: no-sycophancy
mods.description: No flattery or filler. Disagreement is stated plainly, with the reason.

mods.name: no-em-dash
mods.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

mods.name: pirate-mode
mods.description: Talks like a pirate in prose, never inside code, commands or file contents.
